about.description: aHYPER is the ERC-4626 share token of the Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault on Monad. Deposited USDC is deployed by Hyperithm, a digital asset manager based in Tokyo and Seoul, across delta-neutral crypto strategies including funding-rate arbitrage, Pendle PT positions, leveraged interest-rate arbitrage, and lending / DEX liquidity provision. Yield accrues to share price via ERC-4626 convertToAssets. Reserves are continuously verified through Accountable's Proof of Solvency feed at accountable.hyperithm.com.
about.registryInfo: Hyperithm Co., Ltd. is a premier digital asset manager based in Tokyo and Seoul, founded in January 2018 by ex-Morgan Stanley banker Sangrok Oh and Forbes 30 Under 30 entrepreneur Lloyd Lee. Registered as SPBQII operator with the Japan Financial Services Agency and holding a VASP license from the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit. Backed by Coinbase Ventures, Hashed, Samsung Next, and Kakao Investment. The ERC-4626 vault is issued on Monad and verified continuously via Accountable's Proof of Solvency feed.
